insights.headline: Dollar falls on surprise drop in US retail sales
insights.reasoning: A surprise contraction in US retail sales raises expectations for Federal Reserve rate easing and softens the US Dollar index. A weaker dollar generally sparks capital inflows into emerging markets like India and supports global commodity prices. This provides immediate valuation and liquidity support to large-cap domestic equities.

insights.headline: Adani Enterprises, HDFC Bank among 10 stocks with highest increase in mutual fund holdings in value terms

insights.headline: RBI loan recovery rules 2027: New rights for borrowers in default
insights.reasoning: Stricter borrower-protection norms and recovery guidelines may lengthen default-resolution cycles for retail lenders and NBFCs. Financials exposed heavily to unsecured lending and aggressive collection mechanisms face short-term regulatory headwind.
